w: A prayer assembly was held from 5.30 p.m. Brahmadarshan Swami, Viveksagar Swami and Dr Swami addressed the assembly. Thereafter Yogicharan Swami sang “ Vaishnav jan to...” and “ Sant param hitkari...”. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Today, you have gathered here in large numbers. This reflects your faith in God, faith in dharma and faith in the preachings and bhajans of our rishis and great devotees. We have gathered to pray for peace to prevail everywhere. When the sentiments of doing good to others are consolidated in us then there will be peace within and without. By reading or listening to the teachings of Rama and Krishna, the Vedas and Upanishads, and stories of devotees in the Puranas, Ramayana, Mahabharata and Gita one gets auspicious thoughts. The shastras are our culture and mandirs are also a part of our culture. They have given us good thoughts; thoughts of doing good for others. “Our guru, Yogiji Maharaj, was a great sant and very holy. He always used to say ‘May God do good of all.’ He never wished otherwise, even for those who insulted him or pained him. God or his Sadhu do not wish ill of anyone. It is because of one’s base natures ( swabhavs) that one performs bad deeds. And then one has to suffer for one’s sins. The more good one does for others, the more benefit one gets. We pray to Shriji Maharaj in this prayer assembly for the good and happiness of all.”
A peace prayer ( shanti paath ) and dhun were sung for those who were killed in the terrorist attack. More than 40,000 devotees participated in the peace prayer and arti.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for the BAPS hari mandir in Rudel.

A devotee phoned from Canada. His wife had had Pramukh Swami Maharaj's darshan in a dream. In the dream Swamishri told her to make theplas (flatbreads), and the dream broke, but she remembered the dream. So she was left with sorrow in her mind that she had not obeyed the command. So as atonement she even observed a fast, yet the devotee phoned Swamishri on her behalf for an atonement.

Hearing the details, Swamishri said, "This is a matter of a dream. You have seva, conviction and devotion, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj are pleased, so do not keep anything in your mind. God will do good and all will be well; do not worry."

After the meal, a phone call came from America. A seeker had had differences with his wife, and as a result the seeker wanted to marry a white American woman and divorce his wife. In this connection, the sadhus who had gone there on tour had also called the seeker, spoken words of strength and brought about a reconciliation, and he had agreed to give up the American woman. In this context, speaking with the seeker on the phone, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "It is true that there have been differences in the family, but now live together in unity. Forget what has gone before and after. My blessings are that both your lives pass well and there is peace. Keep the strength so that the reconciliation that has taken place lasts for ever."
The seeker, with a feeling of repentance, said, "Please stay pleased."
Swamishri said, "You have obeyed our command, so God will be pleased. You have given up your attachment; that is a very good thing. Attachment is to be given up before God."
The seeker said, "Please forgive any mistakes."
Swamishri said, "You have given up everything at our word, so we are pleased."

Tonight in the night assembly there was a special programme, "Suryapur Kathamangal". In it the history of satsang in Surat was woven together and presented with very beautiful and novel presentations. After watching it, Mahant Swami Maharaj went to his residence at "Madhuram Villa" at 10.50.

Here Suketubhai Sadhak had stayed back for seva and so could not come to see the programme. Pleased with his seva, Swamishri said, "You stayed here and did not see the programme, but everything is contained in seva. Do whatever seva you get, and you will attain Akshardham."
Thus, showing the fruit of moksha in seva itself, Swamishri went into his room.

Last night Mahant Swami Maharaj went to bed about three quarters of an hour later than usual. Yet he woke at the usual time, got ready and at 5:17 took his first step out of his room... But he laughed and said to the sadhus standing on the way, "I thought that today the puja is in the room, so I got ready at leisure."
The sadhus said in surprise, "If he calls this getting ready at leisure, and comes at this time at leisure, what must his hurry be like?"
What is natural for Swamishri becomes spiritual practice for us.
Today after his puja, the children began a question and answer session with Mahant Swami Maharaj. In it one question asked was, "What is the essence of the Vachanamrut?"
Swamishri said, "The essence of the Vachanamrut is to keep a sense of divinity towards everyone."

Another question was asked: "I went to Akshardham in Gandhinagar by car, to Akshardham in Delhi by train, and I will go to Akshardham in America by plane. But how will you take us to the divine Akshardham of Shriji Maharaj?"

Swamishri said, "He will take you like this (snapping his fingers)." Then he said, "You have to do only this much: keep dharma and niyams, and keep God's refuge and God's upasana. If these two are there, you go straight to Akshardham."
Following on from this, someone asked, "The Akshardhams of Gandhinagar, Delhi and America are amazing too, but what must Shriji Maharaj's Akshardham be like?"
Swamishri said, "You will experience it... When knowledge comes, you will feel, 'Akshardham is right here.'"
Finally a child asked, "You say, 'Bapa is always manifest,' so what must Pramukh Swami Maharaj be doing right now?"
Swamishri paused, and then, after thinking, said with a smile, "He is sitting here..."
The hall resounded with tremendous applause.
During the meal Gunvatsaldas Swami started a new topic, saying:
"The milkman uncle delivers the milk every day early in the morning at five or a quarter past five.
I asked, 'If you come so early to deliver the milk, when do you milk the cow?'
The uncle said, 'At 2:30 in the morning!'
In surprise I asked, 'Does she let you milk her so early?'
Then the uncle said, 'Normally she wouldn't, but ever since Mahant Swami Maharaj came, she lets me milk her.'"
Adding their reflection, the sadhus said, "Even the cow has understood that Mahant Swami Maharaj has come, so she has to get up early!"
Everyone, including Swamishri, burst out laughing.
